summary.headline: Only 62/100 frozen matchable requirements end up with a correct usable prediction (Effective Correct Coverage 0.62). Of the 38 shortfalls: 9 are a single job lost to production normalization, and 29 are label errors dominated by Strong->Partial (17).

directional_errors.bias: The matcher compresses toward Partial: it under-credits direct evidence (Strong->Partial 17) far more than it over-credits (Partial->Strong 4), and it never crosses two steps (0 Strong<->Missing).

partial_analysis.interpretation: Partial is used as a broad uncertainty bucket: of 44 predicted-Partial rows, 23 are false positives (17 GT-Strong under-credited + 6 GT-Missing over-credited via adjacency). Only 21 of 44 predicted-Partial rows are genuinely Partial.

adjacency.hypothesis_test: Conceptual/technical adjacency is treated as sufficient evidence for Partial.
adjacency.verdict: CONFIRMED — 5/6 GT-Missing->Partial rows cite general/adjacent evidence for a specialised capability the candidate has no direct evidence for.

or_list.pattern: OR-list handling fails in BOTH directions: (a) over-strict — one clearly-satisfied alternative is downgraded to Partial because other non-required alternatives are absent (GT Strong->Partial); (b) over-lenient — an OR-list of capabilities the candidate has NONE of is lifted to Partial via adjacency (GT Missing->Partial). OR-list reconciled accuracy ~0.44 vs 0.68 overall.

compound_requirements.note: Heuristic compound detector (subclaim/qualifier/tool-list/ownership markers >= 2); sample is small, treat rates as indicative.

distinction.A_evidence_validity: 1.000 — every cited id exists in the frozen 30-item catalog (also enforced by _normalize_matches).
distinction.B_evidence_relevance_sufficiency: WEAK — 27 incorrect Strong/Partial rows cite valid but insufficient/adjacent evidence.
distinction.C_final_label_correctness: 0.681 accuracy — valid grounding does NOT imply a correct semantic label.

grounding_semantics.product_implication: A displayed 'evidence-backed' match can still be the wrong strength. Grounding rate is a safety metric, not a quality metric.

score_propagation.note: GT Match Score = frozen canonical importance x Human label. Baseline (production) = model-predicted importance x model label. The failed job has no baseline score and is excluded.

correlation_decomposition.interpretation: GT Match Score vs Human Match Fit Spearman 0.845 (construct is sound with perfect labels); Baseline Match Score vs Human Match Fit Spearman 0.537; ~0.31 rank-correlation is lost purely to matcher label errors. Matcher quality is the dominant lever, not scoring design.

small_n_volatility.classification: DETERMINISTIC_SCORING / UX robustness — not a matcher-quality issue.

human_match_fit_construct.note: These use GT (human) labels, so they are NOT matcher errors — they show the matchable-only Match Score construct vs holistic Human Match Fit.

explanations: matchable-only: Match Score ignores eligibility (42 rows) and knowledge (16 rows); a job can be capability-strong but eligibility-blocked, or vice versa.
small requirement sets: 1-3 matchable rows -> coarse 0/50/100-ish scores that cannot express a nuanced 1-5 fit.
role/domain mismatch: mismatched-control jobs (Xsolla, 微信语音识别算法) have few matchable PM-style rows; the candidate can 'cover' those while being wrong for the role.
subjective holistic perception: Human Match Fit integrates seniority realism and role shape that individual matchable requirements do not encode.

Strong->Partial (17).rationale: Frozen rubric rules (complete direct project can be Strong; OR-list; no-outcome != downgrade) are not in job-fit-v3; the model defaults to strict reading.

Missing->Partial (6).rationale: No explicit 'adjacent technology is not partial support' guardrail; model credits general AI experience toward specialised capability.

Partial->Strong (4).rationale: No 'match the narrowest unmet sub-claim' rule; skill-list / project evidence over-generalised.

Partial->Missing (2).rationale: Model failed to connect an available adjacent evidence id it had access to.

Unreconciled job (9).rationale: Model emitted a duplicate id (capability); production discards the whole job with no partial recovery (normalization design).

Match Score volatility.rationale: 1-3 matchable requirements make the deterministic score jump 25-50 pts per label flip.

GT-score vs Human-Match-Fit gap.rationale: matchable-only construct + small-N + mismatched controls; not a matcher issue.

benchmark_relevant_issues: Schema adherence / duplicate-id emission rate across models & temperatures
not_solvable_by_model_selection: All-or-nothing _normalize_matches (production normalization robustness) — a code decision, not a model choice
Small-N deterministic Match Score volatility (scoring/UX) — needs a confidence caveat or min-requirement handling
Evaluation dataset representativeness (27/30 Chinese, 22/30 experienced, 腾讯+百度 = 87%) — Dataset V2 scope
Match Score construct vs holistic Human Match Fit gap — product semantics / documentation, not model quality

benchmark_hypotheses.name: Strong/Partial calibration via rubric rule communication
benchmark_hypotheses.baseline_evidence: Strong recall 0.630; 17 GT-Strong->Partial; 8 'generic conservatism' + 6 'project under-credited' + 3 OR-list.
benchmark_hypotheses.target_metric: Strong recall (up from 0.63), Macro F1 (up from 0.692)
benchmark_hypotheses.improvement_bar: Strong recall >= 0.80 AND Strong precision >= 0.80 AND Missing->Partial errors do not increase (<=6).

benchmark_hypotheses.name: Technology/domain adjacency guardrail
benchmark_hypotheses.target_metric: Missing recall (up from 0.667), Partial precision (up from 0.477)
benchmark_hypotheses.improvement_bar: Missing recall >= 0.83 AND no drop in Strong recall.

benchmark_hypotheses.name: OR / alternative-list reasoning
benchmark_hypotheses.baseline_evidence: 10 OR-list mistakes; all GT-Strong downgraded to Partial for missing non-required alternatives.

benchmark_hypotheses.name: Compound-requirement narrowest-unmet-subclaim rule
benchmark_hypotheses.baseline_evidence: 3 errors involve compound rows; 4 Partial->Strong over-credit partly-covered compounds.
benchmark_hypotheses.improvement_bar: compound-slice error rate <= non-compound error rate.

benchmark_hypotheses.name: Duplicate-id / schema adherence across models & temperature
benchmark_hypotheses.baseline_evidence: 1/30 jobs lost to a duplicated requirement_id in raw output.
benchmark_hypotheses.target_metric: job normalization success rate (up from 29/30); duplicate-id emission count
benchmark_hypotheses.improvement_bar: 30/30 normalization success across 3 repeats; 0 duplicate ids.

benchmark_hypotheses.name: Model tier comparison (capacity vs prompt-bound)
benchmark_hypotheses.baseline_evidence: Strong->Partial compression could be capacity- or prompt-bound; not separable from one run.
benchmark_hypotheses.target_metric: Macro F1 delta at fixed prompt across Claude tiers
benchmark_hypotheses.improvement_bar: identify whether a larger tier closes >50% of the Strong recall gap at the SAME prompt.

benchmark_hypotheses.name: Repeat-run determinism check
benchmark_hypotheses.baseline_evidence: Single run at temp 0; determinism assumed, not verified.

benchmark_slices.project_based_evidence_rows: GT or predicted reason references a project/internship (GoFin/KPay/个人项目/Product Owner) as the main evidence.
benchmark_slices.formal_work_experience_rows: source_text implies a formal professional role or a duration qualifier applied to a matchable (not eligibility) requirement.
benchmark_slices.or_list_rows: source_text contains 或 / slash-joined alternatives / '等方向' / '之一' (is_or_list=true in error_slices.csv).
benchmark_slices.compound_rows: is_compound=true: >=2 of {joint subclaim, >=2 '、' list, proficiency/completeness qualifier, multi-tool list}.
benchmark_slices.technology_adjacency_rows: GT Missing where predicted reason credits general/adjacent tech (multimodal/ASR/RL/AIGC/LLM) toward a specialised capability.
benchmark_slices.proficiency_depth_rows: source_text contains 熟练/精通/深入/扎实/proficient/expert or a multi-tool list requiring depth.
benchmark_slices.domain_specific_rows: requirement names a specific industry/domain (证券/金融/医疗健康/battery industry/内容创作).
benchmark_slices.mismatched_control_jobs: role_category == mismatched_control in Dataset V1 (huawei:28183, xsolla:252b30e5, tencent:2064981110395420672).

baseline_decision.keep_as_reference_baseline: YES — honestly measured, fully reproducible, grounding/schema-format reliable; it is the anchor for Benchmark Round 1.
baseline_decision.keep_as_model_candidate: CONDITIONAL — Macro F1 0.692 and Partial precision 0.477 are below a comfortable production bar, and 1/30 jobs produced no usable output. Retain as a candidate ONLY if Benchmark Round 1 (prompt-rule communication for H1-H4) lifts Macro F1 materially and closes the duplicate-id job-loss; otherwise compare against a higher Claude tier.
baseline_decision.drop_as_model_candidate: NOT YET — no evidence it is worse than alternatives; alternatives have not been run.
